# Bank Management

This folder is derived from [billing-accounts-finance.md](../../../billing-accounts-finance.md) and represents a menu or nested menu item. Each non-README Markdown file represents one permanent table workspace tab.

## Tabs

| Tab | Section slug | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| [Bank Accounts](bank-accounts.md) | `bank-accounts` | Maintains the authoritative bank accounts records used by Bank Management. |
| [Bank Deposits](bank-deposits.md) | `bank-deposits` | Manages the end-to-end bank deposits workflow for Bank Management. |
| [Bank Reconciliations](bank-reconciliations.md) | `bank-reconciliations` | Coordinates bank reconciliations as an exception-driven worklist. |
| [Bank Transactions](bank-transactions.md) | `bank-transactions` | Manages the end-to-end bank transactions workflow for Bank Management. |
| [Bank Transfers](bank-transfers.md) | `bank-transfers` | Manages the end-to-end bank transfers workflow for Bank Management. |
| [Matching Workbench](matching-workbench.md) | `matching-workbench` | Coordinates matching workbench as an exception-driven worklist. |
| [Statement Imports](statement-imports.md) | `statement-imports` | Provides a read-oriented statement imports table for analysis, reconciliation, drill-down, printing, and export without duplicating the authoritative source transactions. |
| [Withdrawals & Charges](withdrawals-and-charges.md) | `withdrawals-and-charges` | Manages the end-to-end withdrawals & charges workflow for Bank Management. |

## Implementation contract

- Run the [reuse audit](../../_shared/existing-implementation.md) first; most of this scope already exists.
- Every listed workspace tab is an `AppListTable` worklist or tabular report.
- Forms and workflow actions open from toolbar/row buttons in dialogs.
- Permissions, entitlement, ABAC, human-friendly IDs, export/print, audit, and targeted refresh are mandatory.
- Use the [shared finance contracts](../../_shared/README.md) for tables, dialogs, permissions, API behavior, state, and audit.
